g.text: V7 Mast | published pan-MC state marker panels
Top: corresponding identity / candidate subtype / state. Left: working annotation and cell count.
Size: detection among source-measured cells; x: source coverage <80%. Color: relative expression within each gene.
Rows are exploratory partitions, not accepted fine subtypes. MC_T/MC_TC are RNA-based candidates.
Reference C0-C9 indicate published pan-MC panels, not the V7 row IDs. Original V7 annotation is retained.
